name: Toshi Umezawa
description: A ronin who sought to avoid the great conflict between the spirit and human realms but is at the center of it.

description_citations.text: "Saviors of Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi, in Michiko's employ and beholden to the Myojin of Night's Reach, tries to honor his commitments as the Kami War threatens Kamigawa and a spirit beast threatens the world.
timeline.quote: But as the Kami War threatens to engulf Kamigawa , an unimaginably powerful spirit beast threatens the world.

citation.text: "Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko meets the thief Toshi Umezawa and realizes she may need unthinkable alliances.
timeline.quote: she realizes that to avert the destruction of Kamigawa, she may have to make some unthinkable alliances

citation.text: "Champions of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi goes to the Heart of Frost, gains the Yuki-Onna's frost power and captures her in a magic disk, forcing Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer into the Hyozan Reckoners.
timeline.quote: then succeeds in gaining the Onna's power of frost and capturing her in a magic disk via a kanji ritual.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu plans to raze Minamo and Otawara; Toshi persuades him to attack Jukai first, and they trade items.
timeline.quote: Toshi convinces Hidetsugu that he needs more time and tells him to attack Jukai first.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi goes through the Shadow Gate and barters with Night's Reach for teleportation power, kills Uramon, teleports Michiko to Pearl-Ear and mercy kills Choryu.
timeline.quote: Toshi also teleports to Hidetsugu's lair and mercy kills Choryu despite knowing it would enrage Hidetsugu.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko speaks with Mochi at Minamo, learning what her father took was a daughter of O-Kagachi, as Toshi learns the soratami plan to conquer Kamigawa and Hidetsugu attacks Minamo.
timeline.quote: Then suddenly the academy is rocked as Hidetsugu attacks.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu's forces kill Keiga; at Eiganjo O-Kagachi bites Yosei in half and Takeno dies protecting Konda; Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken, making O-Kagachi disappear.
timeline.quote: Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken and teleports out, making O-Kagachi disappear.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi freezes Mochi and drops the Taken One at his feet, hoping Konda, O-Kagachi and Hidetsugu will fight over it, then teleports Michiko's party back to Jukai.
timeline.quote: Back at Minamo he freezes Mochi with his ice powers and drops the Taken One at his feet

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Night's Reach calls in Toshi's debt and has him leave the Hyozan Reckoners, though his intentions secretly diverge from hers.
timeline.quote: Night's Reach cashes in on the favor Toshi owes her.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Choryu helps Michiko escape Eiganjo; she meets Toshi Umezawa in Jukai, who saves her from the Myojin of Life's Web.
timeline.quote: After saving her from the wrath of the Myojin of Life's Web

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and her party are at Minamo during Hidetsugu's attack and Toshi saves them.
timeline.quote: Once again, Toshi Umezawa saved her and her friends.

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi follows nezumi, overhears their soratami deal, and is chased by soratami.
timeline.quote: thus the soratami start chasing him to silence him

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part II". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu directs Toshi to the budoka monks, and Toshi leaves for Jukai with Kobo.
timeline.quote: So he leaves for the forest of Jukai with Hidetsugu's apprentice Kobo

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part II". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Both groups are captured by orochi in Jukai; Toshi escapes, finds Kobo dead, and rescues Michiko from sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Toshi rescues Michiko who is going to be sacrificed by the Myojin of Life's Web to stop the war.

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part III". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a cave Toshi meets Mochi and the Myojin of Night's Reach, who offers him power; he initially refuses.

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part III". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kitsune and orochi battle outside the cave; Toshi kills the orochi and, blessed by the Myojin of Night's Reach, unsummons the Myojin of Life's Web.

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part III". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi reveals Choryu killed Kobo and sends him flying away; Toshi escapes in mist.
timeline.quote: Toshi reveals that it was Choryu , not the orochi, who has killed Kobo

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part III". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi, despite avoiding the conflict, becomes the center of the war between the spirit and human realms.
timeline.quote: But despite his best efforts, he's not only involved in it, he's at the center of it.

citation.text: "Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi and Princess Michiko must find a way to stave off the impending victory of the kami.
timeline.quote: he must find a way to stave off the impending victory of the kami

citation.text: "Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
